title: Waxed Depot Jacket - Camel
body_html: Built for the long haul, the Waxed Depot Jacket takes our Depot silhouette into tougher terrain with heavyweight, naturally breathable wet waxed cotton from Halley Stevensons in Dundee, Scotland. This heritage fabric breaks in with every wear, made to protect against heavier rain and harsher outdoor environments while getting better over time. Unlike drier wax finishes, wet wax cotton is infused with more wax during production, giving it a softer feel, enhanced weather resistance, and the ability to develop rich character with age. Fully lined with our La Grange Lightweight Flannel for comfort, finished with a corduroy collar, and designed to crease and mold to your shape over time. Rugged, timeless, and guaranteed to look better the more miles you put on it.

title: Coordinates Buckle
body_html:
We all have a spot on the map that resonates with us above all others. It could be any place from the summit of Grand Teton to your back porch. It’s probably NOT your desk, your dentist's office, or the site of your pre-purchased cemetery plot. Regardless, it’s personal. That’s why we made the fully-customizable Coordinates Buckle so you can carry your own coordinates around with you even when obligations send you elsewhere. That’s right, all you have to do is let us know the longitude and latitude you want on your buckle and we’ll have it hammered forever in hot iron by blacksmith Wes Groot, an artisan at Cityboy Forge who spends his days standing over an anvil banging hot metal with a hammer until it turns into cool and original pieces of wearable art.

Please indicate your choice of coordinates in the Buckle Engraving Notes section at checkout. Note: coordinates can run up to 4 decimal places (i.e. 26.5589, -77.1354); and because each piece is custom, these buckles are available in limited quantities.

Cityboy Forge Buckles are custom made for Howler Brothers and not eligible for discounts.

Made of quick drying polyester with a touch of stretch spandex.

title: Loggerhead Hoodie
body_html: The Loggerhead Hoodie is perfect for days when you have to stand in the full glory of the sun and need to pack your own shade. Features include the UPF 35+ protection (we call it “solarshieldability”), a full hood, 100% polyester fabric (with 50% recycled content), microfiber lined stash pocket and reinforced front kangaroo pocket.

title: Emerger Tech Longsleeve
body_html: It’s a no brainer to make a longsleeve version of our Emerger Tech Shirt. It’s one of our best tech offerings and has endless utility. Whether you’re grinding out travel days or going to your nephew’s soccer tournament, this mega lightweight, UPF 35 gem will keep you cool and protected from the sun’s rays without all the doodads and dorkiness of most “tech” wear.

title: HB Tech Hoodie
body_html: Yeah yeah yeah. We heard you. You wanted the super utility of our HB Tech T with a hood. We happily obliged with the new HB Tech Hoodie. Like it’s brethren, the hooded version keeps things light with a blend of recycled polyester and spandex, and UPF 50+ sun protection. You’re welcome.

title: Honzer Hoodie
body_html: The Honzer is a brand new addition to the Howler hoodie lineup that tips it’s cap to late-80’s surf style. But, rather than get too bogged down in nostalgia, it comes strong with soft, cotton-poly blend reverse- slub fleece, and a unique jacquard piping on the front kangaroo pocket. The result is a styling piece that works well as a post surf throw-on or just an overall elevation to your hoodie game.

title: Shaman Hoodie
body_html: The Shaman Hoodie is a unique cotton blend hoodie with a woven jacquard yoke inspired by the baja hoodies you may have seen at surf breaks and music festival parking lots back in the day. The fan-favorite Shaman features a full front zipper, front hand warmer pockets, rear stash pocket, and woven zipper pull cord with leather fobs. Find the spirit world.

featured_image.alt: A dark gray cotton blend hoodie with a woven jacquard yoke featuring colorful stripes and geometric designs across the shoulders and hood. The hoodie has long sleeves, front pockets, and vibrant Baja hoodie-inspired patterns.

title: Crozet Fleece Jacket
body_html: The Crozet (say it, “crow zay”) is the newest fleece family from the Howler design minds. Made of core-warming polyester fleece with cool details like the nylon collar and chest, two-way front zipper, and tonal herringbone taping on the front yoke. Choose between the layerable vest version or go with this full-coverage jacket whenever you need to stay toasty while picking apples, or laying out a lovely arrangement of gourds. You know, fall things.

featured_image.alt: Olive green polyester fleece jacket with a full front zipper, two zippered side pockets, brown fabric patches on the right shoulder and left elbow, and a green collar with a branded label inside—essential fall outerwear.

title: Tajima Hoodie
body_html: We absolutely could not resist making the Tajima Pullover. It is perhaps the most comfortable hoodie-style garment you will ever encounter. Made of cotton-poly fleece with a unique reverse printing, it throws a little streetwear vibe but isn’t too high and mighty to get off the pavement. Wear it out on the town, under your ski coat, or while taking a nap.

title: Denim Depot Jacket
body_html: It was high time we made a denim jacket, and the famed Depot Jacket was the perfect silhouette. We made it ours by adding a lightning bolt stitch on the chest pocket and a unique pocket design. Keep this hanging by the front door for when you need to duck into your favorite dive bar or backyard hang with style to spare.

title: Crozet Fleece Vest

Made of core-warming polyester fleece with cool details like the nylon collar and chest, two-way front zipper, and tonal herringbone taping on the front yoke. Choose between this infinitely layerable vest version, or slide over to the full coverage Crozet Fleece Jacket whenever you need to stay toasty while picking apples, or laying out a lovely arrangement of gourds. You know, fall things.

title: Westers Club Jacket
body_html: Our brand new Westers Club Jacket mashes up western styling with vintage vibes. Don’t worry, all you have to do to become a member is bust out this mid-weight nylon shell and hit the dance halls or shopping malls of your choosing. The low pile fleece inner lining will keep you warm without weighing you down and the western yokes will hold you steady in the saddle all season long. Howlers only.

featured_image.alt: A black zip-up vintage jacket with chest pockets, front hand pockets, an elastic waistband and cuffs. The inside collar is brown, and there is a small stitched label near the hem. The jacket is laid flat on a light background.

title: Voltage Quilted Jacket
body_html: It was time to add a new member to the Voltage Quilted family. Like it’s hooded cousin, the new Jacket version is supercharged with 60 gram PrimaLoft® Gold insulation stuffed into our unique “lightning” quilted polyester rip stop shell. It packs down to nearly nothing and works like a dream under a shell or stand alone.

title: HB Lined Depot Jacket
body_html:
We lined the inside of our stylin’ Depot Jacket with a layer of cozy jacquard flannel printed with some of our favorite patterns from the season. This makes the Lined Depot Jacket a more robust cool weather companion no matter your destination station. All aboard!

Sizing Note: We recommend ordering one size larger than you normally order.

featured_image.alt: A dark blue Lined Depot Jacket in jacquard flannel with long sleeves, a collar, chest pocket with button flap, and two side pockets, perfect for cool weather and laid flat on a light background.

title: Voltage Quilted Vest
body_html: The Voltage Quilted Vest is a super lightweight piece for layering and everyday core warmth with 60 gram PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation packed into our striking "lightning" quilting. Featuring a comfortable and casual rib-knit baseball collar and large front kangaroo pockets.

title: Rounder Vest
body_html: The Rounder Vest ropes the cold on every range with its distinct western styling, core warming Primaloft® insulation and water resistant polyester micro rip-stop outer shell. The Rounder is still the one to grab when you want to straddle the line between cool western stylies and puffy warmth.

title: Free Range Fleece Pullover
body_html: The Free Range Fleece Pullover is the full coverage member of our Free Range familia. It possesses the same simplicity as the vest but packs a little more cold fighting punch for chillier days and demands. The quarter zip pullover set up lets you get in and out quickly when you’re hitting the hot tub post-session.

title: Free Range Fleece Vest
body_html: Our new Free Range Fleece Vest is a no-frills base layer or cool day warmer. Wear this at the family Thanksgiving football fiesta, under your ski shell when bombing runs or walking to your night class. It works for all of them and is a no-brainer add to your bag whenever a chill might hit the air.

title: Super Bueno Palm Cotton T-Shirt
body_html: Inspired by band and tour tees of our youth, this line of t-shirts is a canvas for more experimental artwork that has a timeworn vintage look. Open your mind!

title: Allegheny Fleece Overshirt
body_html: Meet your best friend for fall, the Allegheny Fleece Overshirt. Made of soft and fuzzy high pile fleece with handy HB snaps at the placket and pockets, the Allegheny works like a casual jacket for your happy hour meet-up but doubles as a go-to companion for just hanging by the fire watching the tube.

title: Voltage Quilted Pullover
body_html: The Voltage Quilted Pullover charges up the lineage with a unique easy on and off pullover design and adds a hood for colder days when the elements really bite. Lightweight and easy to pack, we recommend the Voltage as a travel companion for all kinds of weather contingencies ranging from just brisk all the way to blistering. With 60 gram PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation packed into our unique “lightning” quilting, the Voltage is versatile warmth that works equally well as a stand alone piece or layered under a shell.

title: Terry T
body_html: We love making new twists on vintage items. Our Terry Ts upgrade terry cloth surfing t-shirts from a bygone era with new, Howlerfied designs and modern materials. Made of ridiculously comfortable cotton-poly terrycloth with contrast stitching, left front pocket and Howler icon tag at side seam.

body_html: A new edition to our lineup of t-shirts, the Spectrum Pocket T is our solid color, heavyweight cotton jersey option inspired by classic cotton Ts of the 80’s and 90’s. Featuring a ribbed collar and a kaleidoscope of inventive Howler Brothers front pocket embroidery.

title: Stockman Stretch Snapshirt
body_html: The Stockman Stretch Snapshirt is a western inspired snapshirt constructed of a stretchy poly-rayon-spandex fabric that will help you rope and wrestle anything in sight. Throw in the super cool colored snap buttons for a bit of Howler vibe and our original sunglass cleaning microfiber at the hem and you're ready for every ride.

title: Feedstore Tech Strapback
body_html: Our tech hats have become some of our most popular toppers in the last few years. They are easy wearing with a low crown and constructed of quick drying nylon-poly blend. Test them out on your next river day or any day you need a cool, versatile cover.

title: HB Tech Longsleeve T-Shirt
body_html: This is the ultimate throw on for times when you need a no frills cover up. Perfect for hiking, fishing, beaching, yard work and just everyday slounging. It’s lightweight and rated UPF 50+.

featured_image.alt: A long-sleeve, orange Howler Brothers shirt laid flat on a light background. This lightweight cover up features a small logo and text on the left chest, perfect for hiking thanks to its UPF 50+ sun protection.

title: Shores Club Shirt
body_html: Our latest take on the classic camp collar design is constructed of lightweight cotton with dazzling geometric front-pocket and collar embroidery. No matter if you live right on the beach or 1000 miles inland, the Shores Club Shirt comes equipped with all the benefits of a full fledged membership with no application required. Join the club.

title: Tallier Work Shirt
body_html: Impress your boss in our brand new Tallier Work Shirt made of rugged 100% cotton chambray in a heritage American workwear style. Two drop-in chest pockets to keep your gear handy while you stay focused on the job. Get to work!

featured_image.alt: A long-sleeve, button-up light gray Tallier Work Shirt in cotton chambray with two chest pockets and white buttons, laid flat on a light background. A small rectangular tag is visible on the left pocket—classic American workwear style.

title: Conveyer Coat
body_html: Whether you’re travelling across the neighborhood or across state lines, mash the pedal in our Conveyor Coat. Inspired by denim jackets and workwear of the not-too-distant past, the Conveyor’s rugged cotton body, corduroy collar, and subtle tonal detailing straddles the lane between style and utility. Get on the road!

title: Dust Up Denim Snapshirt
body_html: Our Dust Up Denim Snapshirts have been selling out arenas and kicking up dust for a minute now, and the act's gotten even stronger with a dialed in fit. These 100% midweight cotton denim toppers sell out quickly due to their rugged nature and versatile style. Get one before you get bucked.

title: Novato Shirt
body_html: The brand new Novato Shirt mixes a classic western form with vintage vibes of the high desert, 70’s music festivals, and sunshine daydreams. Fear not, you can still pull it off at the pub or at dinner with your folks. No matter where you wear it, you’ll catch the longing glances of others who wish they were as cool.

Dial this one up when you need a little tech on your side but don't want to look all nerdy in the process.

title: San Gabriel Shirt
body_html: The San Gabriel’s clean lines and single pocket simplicity make it essential for every place the sun shines. Built of lightweight and textured 100% cotton fabric, the San Gabriel fits in just as well in Austin as in Abaco. Features include sunglass cleaning microfiber at hem.

title: Sawhorse Work Shirt
body_html: Our Sawhorse Work Shirt is for all those days when you just have to get in the game and start cutting. Constructed of rugged 100% cotton with a subtle herringbone pattern, your Sawdust will get softer and better each time you put it through its paces. Featuring robust antiqued metal snaps and two handy chest pockets for all your assignments.

featured_image.alt: A rugged cotton Sawhorse Work Shirt in dark blue denim with long sleeves, front button closure, two flap chest pockets, and bronze-colored buttons, laid flat on a light background.

title: Reimer's Trek Pants
body_html:
The new Reimers Trek Pants were designed for camping, hiking, climbing and outdoor type things. But, don’t be surprised if you find yourself in these pretty much all the time even if you’re just inside doing a whole lot of nothing. The reinforced knees, stretchy blended fabric and bottom hem bungee set up well for tackling trails and rock faces. But, their easy-wearing nature also work just fine for anytime chilling.

NOTE: Only available in 32" inseam.

title: Shoalwater Tech Pants
body_html: The Shoalwater Tech Pants are designed to take you to places that aren't always dry and friendly. They are lightweight, amphibious and tough as nails. But don't worry, they are equally happy lounging around the house on Sunday afternoon. Made of 4-way stretch nylon-spandex blend with articulated knee and crotch gussets for freedom of movement and comfort, rear zipper and pliers pocket, drawcord waistband and bungee closure at bottom hem.

title: Forager Utility Shirt
body_html: Our new Forager Utility Shirt takes cues from Japanese outdoor gear we've been admiring for years. Vintage styling combines swimmingly with tonal buttons and tough nylon fabric for a sleek, layerable tech shirt that will let you forage with ample storage. The Forager’s range includes hiking trails, bars and urban jungles all over the globe.

featured_image.alt: Short-sleeve olive green Forager Utility Shirt with a collar, orange buttons, and a front pocket featuring a mesh lower section and a small blue label. Perfect as a tech shirt for hiking trails. Laid flat on a light beige background.

title: Guayabera Shirt
body_html: We love reinventing traditional garments and bringing them into the modern age with upgraded fit and fabric. One of our favorite platforms for reinvention is the Guayabera. We based our latest rendition on the classic but gave it some serious Howlerfication with a mesh lined vented back yoke, totally unique embroidery, technical cotton-poly stretch fabric that dries quickly and enlarged pockets for convenient beer storage so you can take your turn throwing washers. Dress it up and look like you have your act together or just throw it on with your flops and boardies.

title: Frontside 5-Pocket Pants - 32"
body_html: It's finally time to meet our retooled Frontside 5-Pocket Pant. We started with our classic and time-tested design but upped the ante by adding durable nylon to our cotton canvas blend. To top it all off, there's a bit of stretch in the weave for comfort and full range of motion, plus we beefed up the construction with triple needle seams, reinforced pockets and bar tack stitching. The result? A super versatile pant that will go anywhere and do anything.

body_html: Designed for grinding away on any labor of love, the ATX Work Pants strike a balance between the comfort of a well-worn pair of jeans and the durability and toughness of traditional workwear. Constructed of our newly developed cotton canvas blend with tough Cordura® nylon and a touch of stretch for unfettered movement, the reinforced knee and kick plate panels will take any beating you throw their way. The two back pockets have heavy-duty snap closures to keep your stuff from disappearing when the going gets tough.

title: HB Trade Pants

We took our inspiration from traditional workwear and added features like bartack reinforced knees and a handy tool pocket. But, to keep them versatile enough for everyday life, we constructed the HB Trade Pants out of blended cotton / spandex fabric with plenty of stretch and high comfort.

title: Chisos Fleece Jacket
body_html: Our Chisos Fleece Jacket is ready to rumble against the colds of fall and winter. Built on the same rich and warm 100% polyester high pile fleece foundation as our Chisos Fleece Vest, but with full sleeve coverage for colder days. Like the vest, the jacket features kangaroo front pockets, a single snap pocket at the left chest and a tonal reminder to Heed the Call on the back collar. This is the fleece you need.

title: Quintana Quilted Flannel
body_html: The Quintana Quilted Flannel is a unique addition to our already deep flannel lineup. The Quintana sets itself apart with a subtly quilted yoke, cats eye buttons at the placket and cuffs, and easy wearing brushed cotton-poly flannel.

title: Talisman Fleece Jacket
body_html: We designed the Talisman Fleece Jacket to pull double duty as the perfect throw on for any cool day or as the ideal baselayer under your ski shell or puffy when you really need to put up a fight against the cold. It's made of super light grid fleece with a fresh nylon yoke and triple pocket configuration to stash your ski pass, energy bar or beer tickets.

title: Rodanthe Blanket Flannel
body_html: The Rodanthe Blanket Flannel is an homage to years past when double duty flannel shirt / jackets were ubiquitous in surf and skate wear. Our Rodanthe has a vintage look and feel and can serve as both an everyday flannel shirt or midweight jacket for fall. Made of 100% cotton heavyweight blanket flannel with reinforced elbow patches and totally unique Bros enamel buttons. Drop in.

title: Chisos Fleece Vest
body_html: Named for the Chisos Mountains in the wilds of West Texas, our Chisos Fleece Vest is the perfect companion for a day when temperatures vary dramatically between dawn and dusk. 100% polyester high pile fleece provides warmth for the core while remaining lightweight and breathable. We added simple kangaroo front pockets, a single snap pocket at the left chest, and a tonal reminder to Heed the Call on the back collar. Use it as a stand alone for autumn pursuits like throwing footballs and frying turkeys or add it in as a mid-layer on the ski slopes or wherever you need core warmth.

body_html: Our Pelusa Fleece pants bring all the comfort and luster of a shag carpet to your legs. With an elastic waistband and gusseted crotch, they’re ready for your apres-ski hang or cold weather coffee run. DUB STORE COLLECTION
Since opening in 1993, Tokyo’s legendary Dub Store has grown into one of the world’s most important reggae distributors, with founder Naoki Ienaga digging through crates all over Kingston, London, and New York to unearth amazing, but often forgotten, reggae roots music. Our Clarksville Walk Shorts are simple, everyday cotton twill shorts designed to keep you rolling on these blazing days. Named for our neighborhood here in Austin and taking cues from our popular ATX Work Pants, the Clarksvilles feature a hidden snap pocket, stretch fabric and reinforced front pockets.

title: Chisos Fleece Vest - Forgotten Forest : Antique Black
body_html: Named for the Chisos Mountains in the wilds of West Texas, our Chisos Fleece Vest is the perfect companion for a day when temperatures vary dramatically between dawn and dusk. 100% polyester high pile fleece provides warmth for the core while remaining lightweight and breathable. We added simple kangaroo front pockets, a single snap pocket at the left chest, and a tonal reminder to Heed the Call on the back collar. Use it as a stand alone for autumn pursuits like throwing footballs and frying turkeys or add it in as a mid-layer on the ski slopes or wherever you need core warmth.

The two back pockets have heavy-duty snap closures to keep your stuff from disappearing when the going gets tough.

body_html:

The original Bing Noserider was first designed in 1965 by Bing Copeland and Donald Takayama for Bing Surfboard's star team rider at the time. This classic traditional surfboard was built for the sole purpose of noseriding. This model thrives in small to mid-size waves in clean conditions. This is the Original Noserider that all noseriders have been modeled after.
